description: Shared shell: the single stylesheet css/wealthcare.css and the site-wide js/nav.js that every page reuses. This is the foundation FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 depend on, so it comes first. It establishes the locked palette/accent, the Google-Fonts @import, the sticky header-nav styles (modeled on street's .section-nav) with the <=640px hamburger behavior, the compliance-banner styles, the footer styles copied from street (hover color swapped #dc3250 -> #2fb8a0), and the shared layout primitives (hero, .card grid, tables, timeline strip, two-lane mapping figure, phone/desktop device frames). nav.js owns the active-link marking and the mobile toggle, with defensive DOM guards per design §10.1.
steps: Create /Users/jefferson/000_coderepo/00_riskrunners-repo/wealth.riskrunners.com/css/wealthcare.css. Start with a reset (* { margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }) and a @import of Google Fonts (Inter 300;400;600;700;900 + Courier Prime 400;700) matching the @import in ../street.riskrunners.com/index.html.

Define CSS custom properties on :root for the locked palette: --bg #08080d, --panel #0f0f18, --border #1a1a2e, --text #d0d0d0, --muted #888, --accent #2fb8a0, --risk #dc3250, --tier-low #2563eb, --tier-med #059669, --tier-high #dc2626. Set body { background:var(--bg); color:var(--text); font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; line-height:1.6; }.

Add a clearly commented 'HEADER NAV' section modeled on street's .section-nav: a sticky bar (position:sticky; top:0; z-index:100; background:rgba(8,8,13,0.92); backdrop-filter:blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px); border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)) with a left wordmark area and a right <nav> link list. Style the Courier-Prime eyebrow tag. The active link (aria-current='page') gets the accent underline/color; links get a :focus-visible outline in --accent. Add the mobile hamburger <button> (hidden on desktop) and a collapsed stacked-menu layout under a @media (max-width:640px) rule, toggled by a class nav.js sets.

Add a 'FOOTER' section copying street's footer CSS rules VERBATIM in structure: footer, footer .brand, .footer-links, .footer-links a, .footer-links a:hover, .footer-links svg. Change ONLY the hover color from #dc3250 to var(--accent) #2fb8a0 (and its border/background rgba accents to teal). Keep the compliance footer line styling.
Add a 'COMPLIANCE BANNER' section: a high-contrast role='note' banner (e.g. teal-tinted panel with a strong border, AA-contrast text on the dark palette), full-width, readable at mobile and desktop.

Add 'SHARED PRIMITIVES' sections reused by later pages: hero (gradient + faint grid via ::before/::after like street's .hero), .card grid (street .card style), semantic table styling, a horizontal/stacked timeline strip, a two-lane mapping figure (two columns of resource chips with connector styling), and CSS-only device frames (a phone frame and a desktop/browser frame built from borders/divs). Keep page-specific rules in the SAME file under commented page sections.
Add a global @media (max-width:600px) block mirroring street's responsive rules so hero/cards/nav/footer stack and nothing overflows at ~375px.

Create /Users/jefferson/000_coderepo/00_riskrunners-repo/wealth.riskrunners.com/js/nav.js (plain ES6, no framework): on DOMContentLoaded, (a) query the hamburger button and menu; if either is missing, console.warn the missing selector and return (non-fatal); otherwise wire click to toggle aria-expanded on the button and a visibility class on the menu; (b) clear aria-current from all nav links, then set aria-current='page' on the single link whose href pathname matches location.pathname (filename match tolerant of index.html vs '/'); if none match, set none and do not throw. Guard every lookup; never throw. Invariant: zero-or-one link has aria-current='page'.
acceptance_criteria: css/wealthcare.css exists and defines the full locked palette as :root custom properties including --accent #2fb8a0 and --risk #dc3250, with tier colors #2563eb/#059669/#dc2626.
The stylesheet imports Inter + Courier Prime from Google Fonts and includes sticky header-nav, hamburger (<=640px), compliance-banner, footer (hover swapped to #2fb8a0), and device-frame styles.
js/nav.js parses with `node --check js/nav.js` and contains no uncaught-throw paths (every DOM lookup is guarded).

The footer CSS class names match street's (footer, .brand, .footer-links, .footer-links a, .footer-links a:hover, .footer-links svg) so street's footer markup renders identically except for the accent hover color.
verification: Create a throwaway /tmp/wc-shell-probe.html in the target root that links css/wealthcare.css and js/nav.js and includes a header nav + a copied street footer, load it headless (`"/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" --headless --disable-gpu --dump-dom --virtual-time-budget=3000 "file://.../wc-shell-probe.html"`), and confirm the DOM loads with no console error and the active link carries aria-current. Delete the probe file and any /tmp/wc-* afterward.
Visually confirm via a headless screenshot at 375 width that the sticky nav and footer render without horizontal overflow.
